1.w: For the one directing. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; they have done abominable deeds; there is no one doing good.

2.w: YHWH looks down from the heavens upon the sons of man, to see, is there one understanding, seeking God?

3.w: All have turned aside, together they have become corrupt; there is no one doing good, not even one.

4.w: All those working iniquity, have they not know? They devour my people they have eaten bread; on YHWH they do not call.

5.w: There they tremble with dread, for God [is] in the generation of the righteous.

6.w: The counsel of the poor you⁺ have shamed, for YHWH [is] his place of refuge.

7.w: Who gives from Zion the salvation of Israel? In YHWH turning back the captivity of His people, let Jacob rejoice; let Israel be glad!
